name: tugasmobile3
description: Ionic web component demo for Coinlore ticker list

scripts.start: npm run build && npx http-server www -p 8100 -c-1
scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html styles.css app.js www/
scripts.cap:add-android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:run-android: npm run build && npx cap run android -l --external
